title: Binance Adds DYDX, FTT, KAVA, VOXEL Cross Margin Pairs and TROY Isolated Margin Pair, Delisting YFI and YFII from Cross Margin
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has added   new  DYDX, FTT, KAVA and VOXEL  trading pairs on  Cross Margin , and a new  TROY  trading pair   on  Isolated Margin . New Cross Margin Pairs: DYDX/BUSD, FTT/BUSD, KAVA/BUSD, VOXEL/BUSD. New Isolated Margin Pair:   TROY/BUSD.  Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits and rates. In addition, Binance Margin will delist  YFI  and  YFII  as borrowable assets from Cross Margin at  2022-05-25 02:00 (UTC) .  Cross Margin Pairs to be removed:   YFI/BUSD, YFI/BTC, YFI/USDT, YFII/BTC, YFII/USDT. Please note: Users can still trade the above assets on other trading pairs that are available on Binance. At 2022-05-23 02:00 (UTC), Binance will suspend cross margin borrowing for YFI and YFII.  At 2022-05-25 02:00 (UTC), Binance will close users’ positions, conduct an automatic settlement and cancel all pending orders on the YFI/BUSD, YFI/BTC, YFI/USDT, YFII/BTC and YFII/USDT cross margin pairs. We will then delist these pairs from Cross Margin. Risk Warning:  Margin trading carries a substantial risk and the possibility of both significant profits and losses. Past gains are not indicative of future returns. All of your margin balance may be liquidated in the event of extreme price movement.
